proof_scope: In progress. R1783 proves the direct density-weighted upper bound ||integral kappa(g).toReal*T_g u dH||_2^2 <= 2*pi*c_H*B^2*D*M^(-1)*||u||_2^2 for measurable probability density kappa bounded by D and zero outside the actual entry box B. Probability, scalar second-moment integrability and the weighted Bochner integral are all verified. Actual generator products, inversion and convolution yield support radius 4*(2*A)^ell when generators have entries bounded by A and 0<eta<=1. Thus the actual smoothed walk satisfies the upper bound 32*pi*c_H*(2*A)^(2*ell)*D*M^(-1)*||u||_2^2. The crude inverse-small-ball density bound is also instantiated without a flatness assumption. For A=2, normalized high-band witnesses and the prior lower bound force (r^ell/2)^2 <= 32*pi*c_H*16^ell*D/2^j. A uniform scalar theorem shows that D^2<=2^j makes this impossible for large j and 2*N*ell<=j with sufficiently large N. Combining the actual lower witness with this barrier yields a restricted quadratic-form gap below 1/2, conditional on the explicitly quantified flatness of the actual smoothed generator walks. No generator family is proved to satisfy that hypothesis yet.
